name: usertrust
description: Financial governance for AI agents. Every LLM call becomes an immutable, auditable transaction with budget enforcement, policy gates, and hash-chained audit trails.

proxy.description: Not implemented. Remote proxy mode is removed; setting this throws (AUD-456). Use a local TigerBeetle or dryRun for enforcement.

proxyKey.description: Not implemented. API key for the removed proxy; unused because proxy throws.

id.description: ProviderPlugin id. Defaults to usertrust. Changing this is how the plugin itself registers as a different provider; attaching the wrapper to live providers is aliases, not this.

aliases.description: Provider ids whose wrapStreamFn this plugin attaches to. Default: anthropic, openai, google (the Model.provider values live calls use). Pass [] to wrap only calls routed to id.

costCenters.description: Operator-declared tool→cost-center attribution + per-turn scarcity injection (Ship 2). Absent: no attribution, no scarcity block.

parentUserId.description: Envelope account identity — forwarded to createGovernor as parentUserId. A single ':' is legal (e.g. 'acct:123'); '::' is reserved for pre-v3 cost-center accounts and refused.

tools.description: toolName -> costCenter. Every value must name a key in envelopes.

default.description: Fallback cost center for unmapped tools / no tool-result run. Must name a key in envelopes.

periodEndMs.description: Epoch ms. Absent means an open-ended period.

envelopes.description: costCenter -> { allocated, periodStartMs, periodEndMs? }. At most 128 entries; each key must match ^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,64}$.

scarcityContext.description: Inject the per-turn scarcity block into the system prompt. Default true when costCenters is present.
